blocks.content: Build and dependency plumbing. Runtime dependency is marked only (for transcript rendering) — everything else is dev tooling. Scripts: dev (vite + electron concurrently), build:main/build:web, typecheck, start, smoke, and dist / dist:dir / dist:win / dist:linux. electron 45 + electron-builder 26 (upgraded 2026-10; npm audit fully clean) targets mac dmg+zip (arm64, unsigned) plus nsis (win.icon = dependency-free build/icon.ico) and AppImage, asar-packed with only dist-electron/dist-web shipped; v5 adds extraResources so bundled-skills/ ships inside the app and scaffolds into the data root on launch. Cross-builds: `npm run dist:win` / `dist:linux` (R12) with CI matrix in .github/workflows/build.yml. 2026-10 hardening: scripts/afterPack.js flips the Electron security fuses on every packaged binary (RunAsNode/NodeOptions/node-inspect off, cookie encryption on, app loads only from ASAR) and then re-seals the bundle's ad-hoc signature — flipFuses rewrites the main executable, and Apple Silicon SIGKILLs an executable whose signature no longer matches (silent). ASAR integrity computation stays disabled (`disableAsarIntegrity`) until the build is code-signed, because builder 26 hashes every *.asar in Resources including exFAT AppleDouble shadows. CI workflow pins all three actions to full commit SHAs.
v3 path fix — the compile layout keeps electron/ + shared/ under one rootDir.
Bumped at each release's final commit.
